function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference guide to the most prominent vaccine manufacturers around the world, along with the COVID‑19 vaccines (and other notable products) they have produced.  If you’re looking for something more specific—such as a particular country’s manufacturers, a focus on a certain disease, or detailed financial data—just let me know and I can drill down further.

| Manufacturer | Headquarters | Key COVID‑19 Vaccine(s) | Other Notable Vaccines / Platforms |
|--------------|--------------|------------------------|------------------------------------|
| **Pfizer‑BioNTech** | USA / Germany | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty) – mRNA | HPV (Gardasil‑9), Hepatitis B, Influenza (Fluzone) |
| **Moderna** | USA | mRNA‑1273 (Spikevax) – mRNA | None yet approved for routine use (research stage) |
| **Johnson & Johnson (Janssen)** | USA | Ad26.COV2.S (Janssen) – adenovirus vector | HPV (Cervarix), Hepatitis B, Influenza (Fluzone) |
| **AstraZeneca** | UK / Sweden | AZD1222 (Vaxzevria) – adenovirus vector | HPV (Cervarix), Influenza (Fluad) |
| **Novavax** | USA | NVX-CoV2373 (Nuvaxovid) – protein subunit | None yet approved for routine use (research stage) |
| **Sinovac Biotech** | China | CoronaVac – inactivated virus | Hepatitis A, Hepatitis B, Influenza (Flu) |
| **Sinopharm (Hepatitis B & Inactivated)** | China | BBIBP‑CorV – inactivated virus | Hepatitis B, Influenza (Flu) |
| **Bharat Biotech** | India | Covaxin – inactivated virus | Hepatitis B, Influenza (Flu) |
| **CureVac** | Germany | CVnCoV – non‑replicating mRNA (under development) | None yet approved for routine use |
| **GSK (GlaxoSmithKline)** | UK | None for COVID‑19 (partnered on Novavax) | HPV (Gardasil‑9), Influenza (Fluzone), Hepatitis B |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** | France | None for COVID‑19 (partnered on Novavax) | HPV (Gardasil‑9), Influenza (Fluzone), Hepatitis B |
| **Merck & Co. (MSD)** | USA | None for COVID‑19 (partnered on Novavax) | HPV (Gardasil‑9), Influenza (Fluzone), Hepatitis B |
| **Biontech (German subsidiary of Pfizer)** | Germany | Same as Pfizer (Comirnaty) | Same as Pfizer |
| **AstraZeneca (UK)** | UK | Same as above | Same as above |
| **COVAXIN (Bharat Biotech)** | India | Covaxin – inactivated virus | Same as Bharat Biotech |
| **Sputnik V (Gamaleya Research Institute)** | Russia | Gam-COVID-Vac – adenovirus vector | None yet approved for routine use |
| **CanSino Biologics** | China | Ad5-nCoV – adenovirus vector | None yet approved for routine use |
| **Zydus Cadila** | India | ZyCoV-D – DNA plasmid vaccine (under development) | None yet approved for routine use |
| **Serum Institute of India** | India | None for COVID‑19 (partnered on Covishield) | HPV, Hepatitis B, Influenza, Polio |
| **Serum Institute of India (Covishield)** | India | ChAdOx1 nCoV‑19 (Covishield) – adenovirus vector | Same as above |

### Quick Notes

- **mRNA Platforms**: Pfizer‑BioNTech and Moderna are the only fully approved mRNA COVID‑19 vaccines as of 2026. Novavax’s protein subunit vaccine has also received emergency use authorizations in several countries.
- **Adenovirus Vector**: AstraZeneca, Johnson & Johnson, and Sputnik V use adenovirus vectors; they are widely used in low‑resource settings due to easier storage requirements.
- **Inactivated Virus**: Sinovac, Sinopharm, Bharat Biotech, and others use traditional inactivated virus technology, which is familiar to many national immunization programs.
- **Emerging Platforms**: DNA plasmid (ZyCoV‑D) and non‑replicating mRNA (CureVac) are still in clinical trials or early rollout phases.

If you need deeper details—such as production capacities, supply chain logistics, or regulatory status in a specific region—just let me know!
